sar.narrative: Customer C13487, holder of card C13487-K1, is the subject of this suspicious activity report. Between 2016-11-15 20:30 and 2016-11-26 17:39, three transactions totalling $439.61 were made online using card C13487-K1 via an anonymous proxy (IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS). Specifically, these transactions include $112.37 on 2016-11-15 20:30 (transaction 3460634), $74.96 on 2016-11-22 16:11 (transaction 3478561), and $252.28 on 2016-11-26 17:39 (transaction 3489320). All sessions utilized the device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080'. This identical device profile was used across 28 cards within a 60-day window, always behind an anonymous proxy and flagged as a new device, indicating an industrialised cyber-enabled fraud pattern linked to confirmed fraud cases such as CC-2985, CC-2649, CC-3035, and CC-2971. During the session for transaction 3478561, the one-time passcode sent to the registered phone was not completed, and when contacted separately, the cardholder confirmed they did not make the purchases and still holds the card. The bank has created a case, monitored connected cards, recommended blocking the card (L1), escalated to an analyst, and filed this report (L2).
